bio: Near the Louvre, this restaurant is the epitome of classy elegance and crisp designer style. The quality of the ingredients is impeccable, and each dish is spot on, crafted delicately and precisely. The chef slips subtle Japanese references into his recipes, such as koshihikari rice with roast scallops, or umeboshi with Racan pigeon. The pastry chef's creations slot seamlessly into this inventive score, a case in point being the ever so subtle white grape dessert. The front-of-house team smoothly and apparently effortlessly supervises every detail of this culinary cocoon. A hipster chilled vibe meets polished professionalism – an unbeatable match!...
